proposals.before: Those seated were in the hundreds; all left their mats and prostrated themselves—only Hu alone sat square facing east, addressing Yi by his courtesy name: "How goes the young lord's eminence!"
proposals.after: Those seated were in the hundreds; all left their mats and prostrated themselves—only Hu alone sat square facing east, addressing Yi by name: "How goes the young lord's eminence!"
proposals.reason: 字謂 here marks familiar address; 邑 is Yi's given name, so 'by his courtesy name' misstates the naming form.

proposals.before: Halfway to a banquet he heard an old woman he knew lay dying of fever in the lane.
proposals.after: Someone once invited Yuan She to a banquet; as he entered the ward gate, a guest reported that a mother known to Yuan She was ill and staying in a ward house to avoid contagion.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic invents 'halfway,' 'old woman,' 'dying of fever'; Chinese only has an invitation, entering the gate, and a report that a known mother was ill and avoiding contagion in a ward house.

proposals.before: Wang Yougong, a county clerk who hated Yuan She, warned Yin, "Humiliate him now and when a real prefect arrives you will crawl back as a clerk while his nameless killers haunt you.
proposals.after: Yuan She had befriended Qi Taibo, a rich man of Xinfeng; Taibo's uterine younger brother Wang Yougong had long envied Yuan She and was then a county gate clerk; he said to Yin, "You as acting prefect have humiliated Yuan She like this—once a true prefect arrives, you will go back as a mansion clerk in a single cart, while Yuan She's assassins are like clouds and kill without anyone knowing the master's name—enough to chill the heart.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits the Qi Taibo friendship and uterine-brother link that the Chinese states, and compresses Wang Yougong's warning so the named relationships are lost.

proposals.before: Rebel chiefs who knew his name hunted him down to pay homage.
proposals.after: Rebel chiefs who had long heard Yuan She's name vied to ask where Prefect Yuan was and paid court to him.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits 爭問原尹何在, the explicit search for Prefect Yuan by title.

proposals.before: Yuan She bolted; Shentu Jian, shamed and furious, announced, "I meant to hold the capital with Yuan Juxian—I would not trade him for one clerk!"
proposals.after: Yuan She wished to flee; Shentu Jian inwardly hated and was shamed by him, and pretended, "I wish to share guarding the Three Adjuncts with Yuan Juxian—how could I exchange him for one clerk!"
proposals.reason: Chinese 陽言 marks feigned speech; idiomatic 'announced' loses the false/pretended force.

decisions.after: All under heaven was in turmoil; for the Grand General to obtain him was like gaining an enemy state.
decisions.reason: Focus unit has 大將軍, not 太尉; the prior literal wrongly borrows Grand Commandant from s0043. The proposal fixes the title but still ends with an extraneous closing quote absent from this narrator sentence.

decisions.after: Hundreds were seated there. All left their mats and prostrated themselves, but Hu alone remained sitting upright, facing east, and addressed Yi familiarly: "How does the young lord enjoy his eminence?"
decisions.reason: 字謂邑曰 marks familiar address to Yi; 邑 is his given name (商子邑), and the spoken form is 公子, so 'by his courtesy name' is wrong and 'by name' still overstates the naming form used in the quote.

decisions.after: Someone once invited Yuan She to a banquet. As he entered the ward gate, a guest told him that the mother of a family he knew was ill and had moved to a house within the ward in hopes of escaping the sickness.
decisions.reason: The prior idiomatic invents halfway progress, an old woman, dying of fever, and a lane setting. The worker identified the problem, but its phrase 'a mother known to Yuan She' was unclear; the context is a family he knew whose mother was ill.

decisions.after: Yuan She had befriended Qi Taibo, a wealthy man of Xinfeng. Taibo's younger maternal half brother, Wang Yougong, had always resented Yuan She and was then a clerk in the county office. He told Yin, "As acting magistrate, you have humiliated Yuan She. Once the permanent magistrate arrives, you will return alone by cart to your old post as a commandery clerk. Yuan She's assassins are as numerous as clouds, and when they kill, no one ever knows who ordered it. The thought should chill you.
decisions.reason: The prior idiomatic drops the friendship with Qi Taibo, Wang Yougong's relationship to him, and most of the warning. The worker restored those facts, but its proposed English was overly literal. Parallel editions also confirm that the corrupt local graph 寫 should be 與.

decisions.after: The rebel chiefs had long heard Yuan She's name and vied to learn where Prefect Yuan was so they could pay their respects to him.
decisions.reason: Chinese 爭問原尹何在 explicitly has the rebels asking where Prefect Yuan was. The worker restored the omitted search, but 'paid court' was too formal and potentially misleading here.

decisions.after: Yuan She planned to flee. Shentu Jian, inwardly resentful and ashamed, put on a show of saying, "I intend to guard the Three Adjuncts together with Yuan Juxian. How could I trade him for a single clerk?"
decisions.reason: 涉欲亡去 is an intention to flee, 陽言 marks a public pretense, and 共鎮三輔 refers to guarding the Three Adjuncts. The worker found all three errors, but its proposed syntax was wooden.
